stemMd: How many different three-person committees can be selected from six people if roles within the committee are not distinguished?
explanationMd: There are 6 times 5 times 4 ordered selections, but each committee is counted 3 factorial times. Dividing 120 by 6 gives 20 distinct committees.

distractorRationale.c: This multiplies people by committee size rather than counting combinations.
distractorRationale.e: This counts ordered selections, distinguishing roles.
distractorRationale.b: This is the number of two-person committees.
